goal: Implement and verify the project-local M7 bounded work-graph runtime without global configuration or live side effects.

nodes.task: Read only the M7 workflow, PRD, schema, evaluation, security, ADR, and existing M5/M6 contracts. Write an exact bounded runtime contract, public API, schema/fixture needs, compatibility seams, acceptance matrix, and test plan. Do not edit implementation paths.

Perform a read-only adversarial design audit of the M7 validator, scheduler, state transitions, context/result envelopes, cancellation, retry/reroute, write ownership, observability, M5/M6 boundaries, and local-only containment. Record fail-closed invariants and required regressions. Do not edit implementation paths.

Implement the project-local M7 manifest/schema validator and bounded runtime from the approved audits: graph/node contracts, admission and route boundaries, lifecycle scheduler, four-worker/depth-one/write-owner guards, cancellation/retry/reroute/serial fallback, bounded context/result envelopes, integration checks, redacted observability, and focused tests. Keep all actions synthetic/local and never mutate global configuration or execute material side effects.

Perform a final independent read-only security and regression review of the completed M7 graph runtime and tests. Verify invalid graphs cannot start workers, graph state cannot be forged or skip dependency/ownership/cancellation gates, M5/M6 material boundaries remain intact, and telemetry/context/audit outputs remain redacted and bounded.

Run deterministic M7 acceptance checks, remediate material findings, write verification evidence and documentation, update status and next-session prompt to the next ready milestone, and keep global activation disabled.
